Full-width layout for comprehensive brand displays
shortDescription: The Brand Grid section creates an organized directory of all brands or manufacturers available in the store. Each brand entry includes the brand name, link to their dedicated page, and an optional product count showing how many items are available. The full-width layout accommodates large brand portfolios while the theme-matched styling ensures visual consistency. Ideal for brand overview pages, manufacturer directories, or partner showcases.
